item.title: Princeton girls basketball team to play for the Division I state championship Saturday night
item.description: The Princeton girls basketball team defeated Wadsworth Thursday night in a Division I state semifinal at University of Dayton Arena.

item.title: Miami finally lost its first game, and now the RedHawks are no lock for March Madness
item.description: The RedHawks became the last men’s Division I program to fall from the unbeaten ranks as UMass rallied in the second half for an 87-83 victory in the Mid-American Conference Tournament quarterfinals.

item.title: Trenton walks back some public comment restrictions days after passing time limits
item.description: Trenton City Council established guidelines for public comment limits at a meeting on March 5. Less than a week later, council members decided to ease limits at a special meeting.
